node.statement: For every geometric simplex sigma, Vert(sigma) is the finite nonempty set of its affinely independent defining vertices and sigma is, by definition, their convex hull. Thus two simplices with the same vertex set are equal: sigma = conv(Vert(sigma)) = conv(Vert(tau)) = tau. Therefore sigma |-> Vert(sigma) injects the simplices of K into P(V) minus {emptyset}; since V is finite, this codomain is finite.
